inputs.text: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) has rightly issued a one-month ultimatum to the federal government, demanding it finally conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. These essential workers have been left behind for years, their contributions to keeping our universities running undervalued amid systemic inequality and institutional neglect that hits labor hardest. If the government fails to act, SSANU is prepared for an indefinite nationwide strike to force accountability. This push comes from resolutions at the union’s 54th National Executive Council, underscoring the urgent need for structural reforms that prioritize workers' rights and challenge the power imbalances that protect elites over the vulnerable staff who sustain public education.
